name: Zetrix AI Berhad
overview: Zetrix AI 今年通过股份购买协议收购 MYEG Ventures Inc. 的股权，间接扩大对 MYEG Philippines,同时与 Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp 及深圳数据交易所签订谅解备忘录，探索新业务合作。此外，公司因未支付 RM25 million 回教债券款项被 MARC 下调评级，并面临政府就 RM314 million JPJ 欠款提起的诉讼。
overview_en: Zetrix AI this year entered into share purchase agreements to acquire equity interest in MYEG Ventures Inc., indirectly expanding its stake in MYEG Philippines, Inc.; it also signed MOUs with Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp and Shenzhen Data Exchange Co. Ltd. to explore new business collaborations. In addition, the company was downgraded by MARC over unpaid RM25 million sukuk and faces a government lawsuit over RM314 million JPJ arrears.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面进行海外联营公司股权收购及探索新合作，同时面临债务与诉讼事项。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the company acquired equity in an overseas joint venture and explored new collaborations, while facing debt and litigation matters.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方同意将上述收购的完成期限延长至2026年第四季度末。
actions.text_en: Both parties mutually agreed to extend the completion timeframe of the proposed acquisition to the end of the fourth quarter of 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 IPVG Employees, Inc. 签订股份购买协议，以 RM130.0 million 收购 MYEG Ventures Inc. 的 15,253,893 股普通股。
actions.text_en: Entered into a Share Purchase Agreement with IPVG Employees, Inc. to acquire 15,253,893 ordinary shares in MYEG Ventures Inc. for RM130.0 million.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与在 NASDAQ 上市的 Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp 签订谅解备忘录，探讨潜在业务合并。
actions.text_en: Entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with NASDAQ-listed Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp for a potential business combination.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与深圳数据交易所签订谅解备忘录，拟共同建立平台以推动东盟数据资产货币化及中国与东盟之间的数据产品流通。
actions.text_en: Entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with Shenzhen Data Exchange Co. Ltd. to jointly establish a platform to secure the monetisation of data as a strategic asset class in ASEAN and enable the orderly movement of data products between the region and China…

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 签订谅解备忘录，探讨与 NASDAQ 上市公司 Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp 进行潜在业务合并。
model_changes.text_en: Signed an MOU to explore a potential business combination with NASDAQ-listed Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 签订谅解备忘录，拟与深圳数据交易所共同建立数据资产货币化平台，进入数据要素相关业务。
model_changes.text_en: Signed an MOU with Shenzhen Data Exchange Co. Ltd. to jointly establish a data asset monetisation platform, entering data-related business.
